items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 10 at 2:47PM PDT until October 12 at 10:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Increased risk of rip currents and sneaker waves
expected with breaking waves up to 16 feet.

* WHERE...Coastal North Bay Including Point Reyes National
Seashore and San Francisco Peninsula Coast Counties.

* WHEN...From Saturday morning through Monday evening.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous conditions are forecast along the
shoreline. Hazards include sneaker waves, strong rip currents,
and large breaking waves.
items.instruction:
Stay off of jetties, piers, rocks, and other waterside
infrastructure. Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous surf
and NEVER turn your back on the ocean. Monitor local weather,
surf and tide forecasts at www.weather.gov/mtr.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 10 at 2:43PM PDT until October 11 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Northwest winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 7 to 11 ft.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Point Reyes to Pigeon Point
California out to 10 NM.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM PDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
